name: procurement-demo
description: The PRD §11 primary demo. Note the wording: 'Ask me before spending more than $150' produces STEP_UP at $203, which is what the demo script shows. See procurement-strict.json for the 'Never spend more than $150' variant, which denies instead.
intent_text: You may spend $500 per month on office supplies. Amazon and Staples are approved. Ask me before spending more than $150 in a single transaction. Ask me before buying from another merchant.

policy.summary: Spend up to $500 per calendar month on office supplies at Amazon and Staples, with your approval required above $150 or at any other merchant.
compiler_notes: 'Amazon' mapped to amazon.com and 'Staples' to staples.com. Verify these are the storefronts you meant.
'another merchant' read as any merchant not on the allowlist.

assumptions: Mapped 'Amazon' to amazon.com and 'Staples' to staples.com. A merchant is only recognized by domain, so a lookalike site would not match.
Blocked gambling, cash advance, crypto, adult, and firearms outright, since the instruction was about office supplies and did not permit them.
Categories other than office supplies require your approval rather than being blocked, matching 'ask me' for anything unexpected.
Set this authority to expire in 30 days. The $500 monthly budget resets each calendar month until then.
Monthly budget follows calendar months in America/New_York.
Spend counts when AgentPay authorizes it, and a pending approval holds budget while it waits.
